summary: The implementation faithfully follows the task spec. All 8 config keys are present with correct defaults. The gate_positive_good function is a pure function with the correct signature, return type, and threshold defaults. It correctly returns True only when both train and val have positive return (> min threshold), PF >= 1.0, and executed_trades meet the floors; missing keys are handled gracefully (returns False). The gate is wired into all four required call sites: _score_pool_rule_on_symbol (returns -999 dict), _robust_combo_return (returns -999.0 float), _try_global_pool_fallback (returns None), and _score_merged_rule_on_splits (returns -999.0). PHASE2_STRICT_POSITIVE_GOOD defaults to OFF, preserving existing pool behavior. The existing PHASE3_MAX_TRAIN_VAL_GAP_PCT gap check remains in place alongside the new gate. The new test file has 20 tests across 6 classes, well exceeding the minimum 6 cases. No out-of-scope files were modified (evaluator_v5.ipynb, GPU engine, EvoX runner untouched). All 20 new tests pass and all 90 existing tests pass.
